prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE production city-map building sprite for tianshu, early-to-middle Qing Jiangnan region, 17th–18th century. The supplied Song Jiangnan image is a REFERENCE for the realistic material detail density and camera, NOT an edit target: generate an entirely new building of the stated type. Orthographic camera yaw45 elevation30; 2:1 dimetric ground projection, BOTH ground axes slopes precisely +0.5 and -0.5, verticals upright, parallel edges, NO perspective. Original South-facing entrance faces screen LOWER LEFT. True transparent RGBA background, all subject and short contact shadow completely inside canvas with at least 10% transparent margins. Very thin flat rectangular ground footprint with all three front ground corners clear; no thick diorama plinth. Realistic ancient architecture sprite, softly weathered off-white lime plaster, charcoal gray small fired clay roof tiles, gray brick/stone bases, dark timber and fine wood lattice windows. Modest Qing-style brick gate surrounds and restrained small carved trim; no ubiquitous imperial gilding, no giant ornamental roof curls. Light screen UPPER LEFT, small soft contact shadow screen LOWER RIGHT. NO sky, horizon, landscape, road outside footprint, humans, animals, calligraphy, labels, pseudo-writing, numbers, signage, watermark, checkers, plastic, cartoon, modern objects. This is an original generic game composite inspired by regional surviving Ming/Qing architectural forms, NOT a restoration of a named monument. Subject: ONE anonymous Qing Jiangnan FIVE-STOREY OCTAGONAL Buddhist pavilion pagoda, with FIVE distinct stacked gray tile roof levels and FIVE white brick storeys. Dark timber balcony rails, gray small tiles, restrained corners and small dark finial. Not a named monument or modern13-eave tower. Square flat7m by7m stone pad. Strict orthographic2:1 SQUARE pad diamond: L=(350,800), FRONT=(750,1000), R=(1150,800), BACK=(750,600), uniformly scale/translate if needed, NO skew. SOUTH ENTRANCE MUST FACE LOWER LEFT: doorway and short steps centered on pad LEFT-to-FRONT edge, not centered at the frontmost diamond corner. Rotate the octagonal tower so entry face projects toward LOWER LEFT. No huge cast shadow or blur, only very short contact shadow to lower right. Whole pagoda intact with ample transparent margins.
